notes.title: Demo 2.0!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We have good news and bad news, bad news is we have to delay the game for a while, we are aiming for December to finish the product as we need a bit of extra time to polish the game and change a few things with the game, we hope you understand BUT we haven't left you empty handed!

We have updated the demo with new features 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664595/4476eab72901c7d54b477f4e7081ef03ff42445c.png[/img]

We have changed the gfx to look more like ps1/ps2 style lighting and models to have that nostalgic feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664595/8232b945299ff03076073bdd8c988405ccee001a.png[/img]

Yes thats right! We added multiplayer into the demo for you all to play!
Play on 3 maps; Pub, Mansion and Town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664595/7929282dd5d977077ffc47beb52e6196c42bec20.png[/img]

We have also put in some new weapons for you to play around with like a SCI-FI MINIGUN or the M249!

Controller support is now in the demo as well with auto aim! (only in singleplayer)
